Manhattan and neighboring settlements

Joan Vinckeboons

The LOC guide identifies Techkonis among the map's village symbols. The Center for Brooklyn History explicitly identifies Techkonis as a documented Munsee community. This supports historical reading, without present jurisdiction or direct descent to a particular government.

Historical scope: Village represented in the 1639 design; surviving copy described as circa 1665
